proof:
classical
obtain ⟨B⟩ := h_T008.2.1.2.1
letI : Module.Free (R p) (MR p M) := Module.Free.of_basis B
letI : Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) := h_T012.2
obtain ⟨ι, hιspec, hιinj, hιrange⟩ := h_T008.2.1.1
obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h_T011.2.1
let eL : MR p M ≃ₗ[R p] L p M :=
  (LinearEquiv.ofInjective ι hιinj).trans
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq (LinearMap.range ι) (L p M) hιrange)
let e : MR p M ≃ₗ[R p] (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)) :=
  eL.trans s.symm
let eQ : (ℚ ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
    (ℚ ⊗[R p] (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0))) :=
  e.baseChange (R p) ℚ _ _
let E : (ℚ ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
    (Ix l → ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) :=
  eQ.trans (TensorProduct.piRight (R p) ℚ ℚ
    (fun _ : Ix l => J p M (ev y v 0)))
have hbase : Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] MR p M) = Fintype.card (Ix l) := by
  rw [Module.finrank_baseChange]
  exact Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B
have hpi : Module.finrank ℚ (Ix l → ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) =
    Fintype.card (Ix l) * Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) := by
  rw [Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
  simp
have heq : Fintype.card (Ix l) =
    Fintype.card (Ix l) * Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) := by
  calc
    Fintype.card (Ix l) = Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] MR p M) := hbase.symm
    _ = Module.finrank ℚ (Ix l → ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) := E.finrank_eq
    _ = _ := hpi
have hn : 0 < Fintype.card (Ix l) := by
  simp [Ix]
nlinarith
